RCE-JEPA: World Coding, with JEPA as Premise

Predict program meaning instead of raw words, let a 49-millijoule checker decide, and cut recurring frontier calls 16.7 times.

[40/40 Hard Tasks Solved · 16.7x Fewer Big Calls]

1/3 Instead of guessing raw code word by word, small models predict compact summaries of program meaning.

2/3 Any AI model may propose a candidate program, but a fast, strict checker alone decides what passes.

3/3 Checking costs over seventeen hundred times less energy than generating, and saved fixes cut big AI calls sixteenfold.

Energy class: reported_j (49.04 mJ chip counter; board_metered=false, never mixed with shunts).
